content:
SRE Bot: [ALERT] prod-kv-cache: sustained p95 growth > 4x baseline across pool-gw-*
Maria: I’m on it. seeing cache size climb and batch size=>continuous_batched tokens spiking.  CPU on nodes looks normal but memory and io climb.
Jonah: any customer-facing errors reported yet?  I’m checking edge logs for 5xx and stream stalls.
Keiko: @Maria can you paste the latest metric window? I want to correlate with batch cadence.
Maria: window: `2026-03-15T03:24:00Z - 03:34:00Z`
- kv_cache_entries_total: 12.1M -> 42.6M
- kv_cache_memory_bytes: 72GB -> 268GB
- continuous_batch_active: 320 -> 1400
- streaming_token_gap_count: 0 -> 480

Amina: ProductOps: a handful of large customers reported increased stream latency and a few token cadence stalls leading to partial responses. no broad 5xx yet.
Jonah: seeing a small spike in partial flush logs: `partial_flush() returned STATUS_INCOMPLETE`  around the same time span.
Keiko: this smells like cache growth triggered by a mis-tuned prefetch/policy combined with continuous batching creating larger KV footprints per request.
Maria: hypothesis: a recent batch config change ramped continuous_batch.max_prefetch_ratio from `0.15` -> `0.6` in canary. That allowed aggressive prefetch and inflated KV pins.
SRE Bot: DeployBot triggered canary rollout 2750009000 at 03:10 UTC: `batch-config:v2` -> `batch-config:v3` for 10% traffic
Maria: rolling that canary back now while we gather evidence. command: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/serving runtime=runtime:v2026-03-14-hotfix` — hold until I confirm.
Keiko: noted. I’ll snapshot KV metrics and start live debug. also will tail `serving.log` for `kv_evict` events.
Jonah: reproducer: `curl -H "X-Request-Size: large"` seq of requests at 200 rps to a test shard caused similar cache pinning in 90s.
Amina: Escalate to Eng-ML? We may need a hotpatch to make prefetch ratio dynamic by request size.
Maria: yes escalate after rollback. rollback applied at 03:28 UTC by DeployBot. monitoring for delta.
DeployBot: rollback completed: `batch-config:v2` reinstated to 100% at 03:28:12 UTC
Maria: good. immediate drop in new entries rate but memory still elevated due to pinned entries and delayed eviction. eviction workers are backfilled but slow.
Keiko: pushing a targeted eviction job now: `kubectl exec -it pod/kv-evictor -- /opt/kvctl evict --older-than=30s --max=200000` — running.
Jonah: customer impact update: ProductOps reports 12 customers saw degraded streaming completions, 3 with notable degradation (SLAs impacted). No data loss. telemetry shows partial flush events aligned with peak.
Amina: drafting an incident summary for customers: include mitigation steps and ETA for full cache recovery (~20-30m after eviction job completes).
SRE Bot: automation: created ticket INC-2750012345 in PagerDuty with severity=P2
Keiko: eviction job progress: 85k entries evicted, I see eviction throughput plateauing due to GC on older TPU nodes. considering temp-scale up of evictor workers.
Maria: request approved. scaling evictor deployment to x4. `kubectl scale deployment/kv-evictor --replicas=4 -n inference`
Jonah: after scaling, eviction throughput jumps. memory trend now downward across pools.
Maria: final verification: continuous_batch_active back to baseline 300 -> 310, streaming_token_gap_count 480 -> 12, partial_flush events dropped to near-zero.
Amina: customer message: "We mitigated a cache-prefetch regression caused by a canary batch config. We rolled back the change and ran targeted eviction; latency and partial responses restored. We'll follow up with a permanent fix." sending now.
ProductOps: please include the RCA timeline and note the canary rollout id and rollback time.
Maria: handing over to @Keiko for postmortem and Eng-ML follow-up. oncall ends at 04:00 UTC. @Jonah please stay as secondary for 30m.
Keiko: taking handoff. I'll capture metric snapshots, config diff, and repro steps. next steps: rework prefetch gating (by request token-size) and add synthetic tests to exercise partial flush path.
Jonah: adding an alert to detect p95 cache growth rate with a short window so we catch regressions earlier.
SRE Bot: oncall handoff: Maria -> Keiko at 03:55 UTC. ticket INC-2750012345 updated with actions and owners.
Keiko: thanks all. will post the PM ASAP. :thumbsup:
